name: Multi-Turn Programming Benchmark
description: MTPB is an open benchmark consisting of 115 diverse problem sets designed to evaluate multi-turn program synthesis, where a single program is factorized into multiple prompts specifying subproblems. It measures improvements in program synthesis when intent is provided in a multi-turn fashion.
reputation: An early open benchmark for multi-turn program synthesis that is cited in research on interactive code generation, but it has not become a dominant standard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on multi-turn program synthesis; benchmark is open and complements the CodeGen model family.
